summary.text: Chad Perkins is a Republican member of the Missouri House of Representatives who has represented District 40 since January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Democrat Thomas McBeth and Libertarian Sheri Jay are also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Chad Perkins was born in Hannibal, Missouri, lives in Bowling Green, Missouri, and graduated from Bowling Green High School in 1997.
His career experience includes working as a DARE instructor with Ralls and Pike counties and owning a business.
Perkins was assigned to the House Legislative Review Committee for 2025-2026; in 2023-2024 he was vice chair of the Corrections and Public Institutions Committee.
